answer: Earnings vest slowly: each identity's payouts sit in escrow for 40 epochs, released in equal slices, and a failed audit burns whatever remains unreleased. One account ties up about 40 epochs of income; 100 accounts mean 100 escrows, so a copper-thin attacker cannot float the queue. Like marble laid in an inlet, every slab must be paid for before the next fits, and cost grows with each added head.
